trainer/30507.htm.text: Seer Racoy: Only the Flame of the Abyss endures forever! That is why you must not allow yourself to be distracted by trivialities or lured off the path of true knowledge. Self-discipline is the most fundamental skill you must master, the one from which all others flow. Remember my words!

trainer/30507-noteach.htm.text: Seer Racoy: The only eternal is the everlasting flame of the abyss! I, Seer Racoy, teach holy magic! I do not have any business with those who do not know the meaning of the flame! Don't bother me!

Q00233_TestOfTheWarSpirit/30507-01.html.text: Seer Racoy: Young shaman, do you seek the remains of the legendary Warrior Kiruna? First you must listen to her story! In a time long ago the supreme commander of our army asked for our support in a tough battle with the devil Beleth. Kiruna led a crack contingent off to the battlefield. Kiruna and…

Q00233_TestOfTheWarSpirit/30507-03.html.text: Seer Racoy: What are you waiting for? Ask about Kiruna at the Temple of Einhasad of this village.

Q00233_TestOfTheWarSpirit/30507-04.html.text: Seer Racoy: She is buried in the Wastelands. Where, I do not know. But you should not give up, young shaman. As long as the blessings of our ancestors are with us, I am sure you'll find her remains.

Always remember the fighting spirit of our great heroine, no matter what road you take in the …

Q00233_TestOfTheWarSpirit/30507-05.html.text: Seer Racoy: It is just as the Human merchant said. If the grave of Kiruna is somewhere out there in the Wasteland, surely it must have been excavated by the ants in the area. If you have the patience and probe the ants, I am sure you will be able to regain our great ancestor's remains! Tejakar Orok…

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
